svg.title: Six review themes with their essence, three questions each and a pass or fail criterion
svg.desc: Six rows. Hosting model: redundancy is bought with money but must hold at every layer, asking how many links, how many devices and whether they are physically separated, passing only when every single point is named and accepted. BGP policy: outbound is controllable while inbound can only be influenced, asking whether the attribute affects the outbound path or the return path and whether return capacity is sufficient, passing when inbound has a tested primary and backup. Stateful devices: the part BGP cannot manage, asking where the state is, how it is synchronised and how old sessions end, passing when new sessions work and old sessions end according to a documented plan. Addressing and NAT: a ten-year asset plus runtime state, asking provider-independent or aggregatable, and whether each ISP has its own pool, passing when a carrier change needs no renumbering and sessions are traceable. Security boundary: a DMZ is a trust level rather than a VLAN, asking what the DMZ can reach inside, passing when lateral movement after compromise is contained and audited. Elasticity: the capacity to survive attacks lives upstream, asking what happens when the link is saturated and who triggers recovery, passing when an attack rehearsal shows a defined recovery time.
svg.text: Six themes, six pass/fail criteria: the review that finds the missing design
Each row is a question the design must answer in writing. A row without an answer is not a gap in documentation - it is an outage waiting.
主题
本质
三个必答问题
成败判据
宿主模型
用钱买冗余，但冗余要在每一层成立
几条链路？几台设备？物理上分离吗？
每层单点都被点名并接受
BGP 策略
出向可控，入向只能影响
属性影响出向还是回程？回程容量够吗？
入向有主备兜底且演练过
状态设备
BGP 管不了的那一部分
状态在哪？怎么同步？旧会话怎么结束？
新会话可用，旧会话按预案结束
地址与 NAT
十年资产 + 运行时状态
PI 还是 PA？每 ISP 独立池吗？
换运营商不需重编址，会话可追踪
安全边界
DMZ 是信任等级，不是 VLAN
DMZ 能到内网什么？
受损后横向移动被限制并有审计
弹性
抗攻击容量在上游，不在机房
链路打满时怎样？谁触发、多快恢复？
攻击演练有明确恢复时间
How to run the review in forty minutes
One row at a time, one owner per row, and no answer accepted without a test or a document reference. The value is not the table - it is that
the six owners discover they disagree about which exit the DMZ uses, or who is allowed to withdraw a route at 03:00.
A design that passes five rows and fails one has the availability of the row it failed, not the average of the six.
